notes: EBIT is proxied as “Operating income (loss)” from the Consolidated Statements of Operations; this excludes interest and taxes by definition. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

D&A and capex come from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: “Depreciation and amortization” and “Purchases of property, plant and equipment” (converted to absolute positive outflows). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

NWC is computed as Total current assets minus Total current liabilities at fiscal year-end (includes cash), which may overstate working-capital needs versus a cash-excluded definition. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Forecast NWC_pct_sales is judgmental and set to a normalized low level despite volatile historical NWC driven by post-separation reporting and balance-sheet structure. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Comps EV/NTM inputs are populated using EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA shown in market-data statistics pages, which are not explicitly labeled as NTM; therefore they are treated as proxies and flagged accordingly.

catalysts: Sustained AI/data-center HDD demand and ongoing ramp of high-capacity drives could keep revenue growth above base-case. ([westerndigital.com](https://www.westerndigital.com/en-ap/company/newsroom/press-releases/2026/2026-01-29-western-digital-reports-fiscal-second-quarter-2026-financial-results))

Shareholder return execution (repurchases and dividends) and further balance-sheet optimization can change equity value perception. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Monetization of WDC’s retained Sandisk stake is expected within about one year from separation actions; realization could affect net asset value. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))
company_overview: Western Digital is a leading developer and manufacturer of data storage devices based on HDD technology, serving cloud/hyperscale, enterprise client, and consumer end markets. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Post-separation (Flash spun out to Sandisk in Feb 2025), WDC reports on a continuing-operations basis focused on its HDD business. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

FY2025 fundamentals show a sharp revenue recovery versus FY2024, with operating income returning to profitability. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))
current_context: Fiscal Q2 2026 (ended Jan 2, 2026): revenue of $3.017B (+25% YoY) and operating income of $908M (operating margin 30.1%). ([westerndigital.com](https://www.westerndigital.com/en-ap/company/newsroom/press-releases/2026/2026-01-29-western-digital-reports-fiscal-second-quarter-2026-financial-results))

Fiscal Q2 2026: cash flow from operations of $745M and free cash flow of $653M, with management highlighting capital returns. ([westerndigital.com](https://www.westerndigital.com/en-ap/company/newsroom/press-releases/2026/2026-01-29-western-digital-reports-fiscal-second-quarter-2026-financial-results))

Q3 FY2026 outlook (midpoint): revenue expected to be ~$3.2B, and company guides non-GAAP tax rate ~0.16. ([westerndigital.com](https://www.westerndigital.com/en-ap/company/newsroom/press-releases/2026/2026-01-29-western-digital-reports-fiscal-second-quarter-2026-financial-results))
investment_highlights: Base-case thesis chains HDD revenue growth to continued data center build-out and adoption of higher-capacity drives, consistent with management’s recent demand framing. ([westerndigital.com](https://www.westerndigital.com/en-ap/company/newsroom/press-releases/2026/2026-01-29-western-digital-reports-fiscal-second-quarter-2026-financial-results))

EBIT margins are assumed to normalize after FY2024 weakness while remaining meaningfully above pre-rebound levels; target EBIT margin of 0.165 by 2030. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Capital intensity is modeled via normalized D&A and capex as a percent of sales (capex ~0.05–0.055 of revenue), supported by FY cash flow statement trends. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Working capital intensity is set low in the forecast (NWC ~0.05 of sales) reflecting FY2025’s post-separation balance sheet structure; DCF includes explicit NWC driver. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Liquidity and capital allocation (deleveraging and shareholder returns) are supported by FY2025 cash generation and announced repurchase/dividend actions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))
key_risks: HDD industry cyclicality and potential manufacturing underutilization charges can pressure margins and cash flow versus modeled normalization. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Macroeconomic shocks, tariffs/trade restrictions, and demand volatility could create downside to both revenue growth and EBIT margin. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

Balance sheet and tax uncertainties (including NOL limitations under 382/383) can alter effective tax rate and value-accretion from tax shields. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))

presentation.subtitle: WDC DCF Inputs: HDD demand rebound, margin normalization, and disciplined capital allocation
valuation_summary: DCF base case uses operating income as EBIT and a gordon_growth terminal value with 0.02 terminal growth and conservative long-run normalization of margins. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/106040/000010604025000038/wdc-20250627.htm))
Discount rate uses a StockAnalysis-derived WACC input (0.1398) and is stress-tested in bull/bear scenarios. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/wdc/statistics/))
Comparable multiples are used as a cross-check with EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA proxies and forward P/E from market-data summaries, flagged as NTM-labeling limitations in notes.
